slides.text: Read this when you feel like quitting tonight.
You are not behind. You are building in silence.
Discipline is the promise you keep when nobody is watching.
The version of you that wins was built on days you did not feel like it.
Stop waiting to feel ready. Start, and let the feeling catch up.
Comfort asks nothing today and takes everything tomorrow.
Same road. Same night. Different decision. Save this and send it to someone who needs it.
